## Evidence

- `db/src/db/assertion.py` — `assertion_from_record` persists the
  record's `candidate_identifier` `{scheme, value}` into `value_json`
  (additive merge into an existing object; a malformed pair, a
  non-mapping `value_json`, or a *conflicting* pre-existing
  `scheme`/`value` rejects to `assertion_quarantine` —
  `missing_required_field`). The claim's text value and
  `content_digest` are byte-unchanged: `content_digest(claim)` hashes
  the **record** mapping (`db/src/db/claim_sink.py:1580`), never the
  derived jsonb — proven by test.
- `exports/src/exports/jurisdictions.py` — `jurisdiction_key` (K4 §3.2
  map via `key_for_declared`; declared-but-unmapped schemes key under
  the national `<scheme>:<code>` form; `sig.unresolved` mints no key),
  `jurisdiction_slug` (slug of the declared KEY — `iso3166-2:US-OK` →
  `iso3166-2-us-ok`), `JurisdictionSchemeConfig` +
  `load_jurisdiction_scheme_config` reading the committed
  `sources.toml` / `camera_registry_targets.toml` /
  `dot_511_targets.toml` declarations — `(source, value)` first (a
  multi-scheme source resolves per value), a single-scheme source
  fallback second, nothing minted from an ambiguous config; every
  derivation's basis is `declared_scheme_from_config@<sha256>` of the
  file actually read. `DECLARED_SCHEME_FROM_CLAIM =
  "candidate_identifier"` labels a claim-carried pair.
- `exports/src/exports/shaping.py` — `shaping_claims` selects
  `c.value_json::text` (24th column; `parse_shaping_claims` tolerates a
  23-column pre-P35.18 row set); `_jurisdiction_display` keys each
  `camera_jurisdiction` claim's bucket on its declared pair (or the
  labelled config basis, or honestly bare); every `ValueObservation`
  carries `scheme` + `scheme_basis`; `jurisdiction_scheme_mix_violations`
  is wired into `build_shaped_dataset` — a scheme-keyed claim sharing a
  bucket with an undeclared bare value is a build error (JUR-02a);
  `SHAPING_SCHEMA_VERSION` → `p35.18/1.2.0`.
- `exports/src/exports/spine_export.py` — the jurisdiction dossier and
  coverage-gap subject ids slug the declared key via
